analysis: Per-case Wilson/Newcombe 95% intervals; 0.3 means 30 percentage points. Primary outcome is factual_contract plus workspace_untouched, or task/no_skill checks for negatives. Skill reads are observations, not quality graders. Report per-case skill names, per-arm costs/token/latency. Six positive cases are three task families, two fixtures each; do not pool heterogeneous cases into one inferred population. Three repeats are exploratory, not powered for small effects. No automatic adoption. Engineering adoption requires reproducible quality/process benefit, zero observed extra negative skill reads, and acceptable cost; no reading-only claim. Same model/settings/tools/fixtures; only frozen preamble appendix varies. No untested semantic rubric is enabled.

prompt.content: When the task matches a workflow description in the read_skill catalog, read the relevant skill before proceeding with the task. For a simple lookup or calculation with no matching workflow, proceed without loading a skill.

exclusions: No red reruns or slot additions. List infrastructure/undecidable/unknown costs separately. Preserve failed factual checks and frozen cases. Fixing a grader or prompt after observing results requires a new protocol and report; it cannot repair this denominator. The first experiment skill-prompt-quality-20261115 is instrument diagnosis only: constructor notation and an affected wrapper caused false negatives. Its 48 trials/costs remain intact, never merged with this experiment. explore-ledger/explore-worker/review-pages are now @2; original case bodies archived alongside the first protocol. Both prompt arms, model, repeat count, thresholds and pricing are unchanged. The second experiment skill-prompt-quality-20261115b exposed another representation-only false negative (Ledger()). It too is preserved as diagnostic evidence, not pooled or regraded. Explore cases now @3 accept the actual module-qualified class/function names, optional empty parentheses and whitespace, while wrong modules/callers and missing edges still fail. Review/synthesis and negative cases, model, prompt arms, repeats, thresholds and prices remain unchanged. This is a new instrument version, not a rerun of a red slot.
hypothesis: Candidate increases relevant skill reads. Task quality is the primary outcome; increased reading alone is not an improvement. Any quality regression or negative-task skill use counts against adoption.

pricing.source: Conservative ceilings copied unchanged from same-day archived skill-autoload-20261115b protocol (pricing source: DeepSeek official pricing checked 2026-11-15). Applied to all measured input including cache reads; estimated upper bounds, not provider invoices.

question: Does a relevant-workflow-first prompt improve factual task quality while preserving negative-task selectivity?
stopping_rule: Each of 48 slots once. Stop on unknown cost, USD3 cap, execution drift or interruption. Existing immutable claim/identity guards apply. Expected cost about USD1.5-2.0, uncertain for new structured tasks; never exceed cap to fill slots.
